title: Announce age-aware route selection
description: Record GNSS wall-clock received_at timestamp in gradient table entries. Use (now() - received_at) as tiebreaker in route selection: prefer recently-received announces over stale ones, after hop count. On mesh rejoin, evict gradient entries older than GRADIENT_TIMEOUT immediately instead of waiting for natural expiry. Spec: 05-routing.md §9.3-9.4. All three impls.
